key_gap: vs baseline: no correctness gap — both sides converge on the habit-rung reframe and plan (week-1 activation instrumentation, onboarding to the aha event, T−45 re-engagement at >40% decay, page work only for the non-decayed cohort, +8–12 pts in 2 quarters). The v5 AI gaps are closed by the routed pass: the climb (renewal page → mechanics → value realization → habit; 'the subscription is bookkeeping for continued usage') is now the m042 contract's first move at WHAT instead of a level-check afterthought, and the re-climb falsifier (quarter-1 cohort study: no activation→renewal correlation → abandon habit, re-test price) is wired into the plan's go/no-go with a numeric threshold from the m006 provenance gate (activated cohorts must renew >=65% vs <55%) instead of sitting in the packet; remaining delta is structure/uncertainty only.
learning_signal: On diagnose+maximize metric-regression signatures with a decay-concentration pattern (c:unmeasured), the m042 first-class pass — climb to the goal rung first, select the rung by which abstraction the evidence concentrates under, descend to concrete Monday actions with owners and time scales, anchor every line back to the ledger metric — converts frame-late runs into frame-first runs and matches the elite baseline on its home turf; the R3 m006 gate (unmeasured) prices the expectation as >=3 likelihood scenarios with a posterior range and a demonstrated threshold flip.
suggested_improvement: Keep m042 top-1 on diagnose+maximize with metric-regression/unmeasured signatures; make the climb mandatory-first in WHAT (rung chain recorded before any optimization, one rung per step); require rung selection to cite the discriminating concentration evidence (80%/>40% decay vs <15% retained, flat elasticity, win-back failure); require the descent to name at least one concrete action per rung with an owner and time scale; wire the falsifier as the plan's go/no-go with a numeric threshold (not only a packet note); keep the ladder-drift guard (each line returns to the ledger metric) as a standing contract item.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style fell into the registry's own weakness — ladder drift, lost concreteness (02:14 pool exhausted → climbed to change governance, scheduled the descent for Monday, treated the exact value as 'an incidental token,' leaving ~60% of payment requests failing at $6K/min). The routed run holds the v5 AI win because the router itself refuses to route m042 on the deadline signature (its learned triggers are unmeasured-context) and dual-routes m015+m021 as contract-checked passes: the m015 classification (single fault mode + single fresh change + reversible snapshot = simple) plus the priced probe (restore-as-cheapest-discriminating-action) and the m021 OODA tempo commit force restore-before-climb; v5's E5 stabilize-first was a situational route, v6's restore-first is contract-enforced.
learning_signal: The abstraction ladder has a floor: the task's time horizon sets the abstraction level — minutes means the exact key, value, scope, and timed verification ARE the deliverable, and climbing (capacity policy, change governance) is a post-stabilization REVIEW item, never a pre-restore plan; a reframe that cannot name key/value/scope/verification within the task's horizon is drift, not abstraction. Deadline+diagnose signatures must never single-route the laddering style; tempo styles (m015 act-first, m021 OODA) are the protective pairing.
suggested_improvement: Enforce the anti-drift floor check at META/WHAT: when the signature is deadline + diagnose/estimate with a known recent change and a reversible snapshot (simple/chaotic domain), (a) DO the concrete restoration before any WHY climb with the descent naming exact identifiers, values, scope, and a timed verification (<2 min); (b) cap pre-action diagnosis at the ~30-second check that points the first action; (c) move every class-level climb to REVIEW after verification; (d) keep tempo mode (P2), P3 failure-branch pricing (escalation staged if verification fails), and the KB trigger that refuses the drifting style on deadline signatures.
